purpose: automate checks of the user interface so that regressions in the main journeys are caught on every change, with tests that are stable
entry_criteria: A test environment with test data exists
A UI automation tool is chosen
procedure: Choose the few journeys that matter most to the business and automate those first, rather than every screen.
Find elements with stable test identifiers or accessible roles, not with brittle positions or generated class names.
Make each test independent: it creates its own data and does not rely on another test's result.
Wait for conditions, never for fixed delays, and keep assertions on what the user sees and can do.
Run in CI on every change for the fast set, and nightly for the wider set, capturing screenshots and traces on failure.
Track flaky tests, and fix or remove them within an agreed time.
acceptance_criteria: Tests are independent and use stable selectors
Failures give a screenshot or trace
Flaky tests are tracked with a deadline

validation.command: npx --no-install playwright test --reporter=line   # example; use the project's tool

validation.expect: no intermittent failure in five runs

failure_modes.response: Fix the wait or isolate the data

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Five journeys are automated: sign up, sign in, search, add to basket and pay. Each creates its own user, waits on visible conditions, and attaches a trace on failure; the checkout test ran five times without a flake.
